response.text:
I can’t keep watching the portal in the background or message you later unless a real automation is created — I won’t pretend I’m monitoring. I can help right now to make sure you get notified automatically. Options:

- I can walk you through (or draft the exact steps/messages for) enabling notifications in the vendor portal if it supports report/asset alerts.
- I can draft a short email to the vendor asking them to notify you as soon as the SOC 2 report is published.
- I can provide step-by-step instructions to set up an automation (Zapier/Make/IFTTT) or an email filter that sends you an SMS/Slack message when the report appears.
- If you want to wait a few minutes, I can check the portal for you now and report back immediately.

Which would you like me to do right now?
